newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says six Moslem rebels killed.
newsitem.headline: Manila says six Moslem rebels killed.

text.p: Philippine soldiers killed at least six members of a Moslem rebel group hours after they had attacked the mayor of a town in the southern Philippines, military authorities said on Friday. Soldiers tracked down the guerrillas belonging to the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) on Thursday after they had ambushed Siocon town mayor Jesusa Pastor, Captain Salih Indanan of the Armed Forces southern command information office said.
Two people were killed during the ambush and the mayor was injured.
The six rebels were killed in a 50-minute gun battle, Indanan said.
The government had been conducting exploratory peace talks with the MILF, a breakaway Moslem faction which is fighting for an Islamic state in the southern islands.
The MILF was not part of the peace deal forged by Manila last year with the mainstream Moro National Liberation Front.
